DGCP deploys capital across global real estate markets, structuring premium opportunities in equity, debt, and hybrid instruments across the GCC, European, and US gateway markets. Built on the Group's premier development platform and powered by institutional discipline and analytical rigor, DGCP creates access to high-conviction strategies and proprietary deal flow for qualified investors and strategic partners.

We are pioneering new ways to access premium real estate investments through tokenization and digital ownership structures.
By leveraging advanced property technology, we aim to enhance liquidity, broaden investor access, and create more efficient pathways into high-quality luxury real estate assets globally.

Discover DarGlobal: Your Gateway to Luxury Real Estate Investment

DarGlobal is a premier international luxury real estate investment and development platform specialising in architecturally distinctive, design-led residences in the world's most sought-after destinations. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, we connect global capital with curated luxury living and property investment opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, and beyond.

Our elite portfolio spans masterplanned communities, branded luxury apartments, and hospitality-led destinations developed in partnership with iconic names from automotive, fashion, and hospitality. Whether investors seek recurring rental income, long-term capital appreciation, or geographic diversification, DarGlobal structures high-value real estate assets to align perfectly with institutional risk and return objectives.

With a seasoned leadership team, robust corporate governance, and a differentiated lifestyle brand, DarGlobal offers unparalleled access to exclusive projects that blend world-class architecture, resilient market fundamentals, and enduring desirability for global property buyers.

blogPost.headline: Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion
blogPost.description: Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million).

blogPost.headline: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
blogPost.description: Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.

blogPost.headline: Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest
blogPost.description: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October.

blogPost.headline: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
blogPost.description: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million).

blogPost.headline: Dar Global appoints Gulf Asia Contracting for Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai
blogPost.description: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has awarded the construction contract to Gulf Asia Contracting for the podium of Trump International Hotel & Tower, Dubai. Following the successful completion of all enabling works, due in September 2026, this appointment marks the project's transition into the next stage of construction and another significant milestone in the delivery of one of Dubai's most anticipated luxury developments.

blogPost.headline: Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
blogPost.description: Dar Global  and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally.

We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our international portfolio spans exquisite residences, vacation retreats, world-class hospitality, and developments with iconic luxury brands, including Aston Martin, and Lamborghini. Design. Lifestyle. Investment value. Every DarGlobal property seeks to enrich all three.

True global citizens want to live without borders. Or compromises. We offer thoughtfully designed homes in desirable settings that cater to your international way of life. Freedom and flexibility. Comfort and culture. Security and service. Wherever you go, find the fundamentals here.

We draw on over 31 years of luxury development experience to move with agility. Adapting to stay ahead of the market. Anticipating investors’ needs. Leveraging exceptional talent and partnerships. Always guided by purpose. Our commitment to quality and people-first thinking sets us apart. We don’t just build differently. We’re built different.

paragraphs: Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million).

The project will be developed on land acquired for a consideration of approximately USD 56 million, further strengthening Dar Global's presence in one of Saudi Arabia's key real estate markets. The acquisition forms part of Dar Global's programme to expand its Saudi Arabia portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, and further land acquisitions will be announced shortly. On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion.

The development is also set to introduce a new international luxury brand to Jeddah through an exclusive co-branded residential concept, further strengthening the city's luxury real estate offering. The expansion follows strong market demand for Dar Global's existing developments in Jeddah, including Trump Plaza and Padel Living, reflecting sustained appetite for high-quality, master-crafted residential and mixed-use developments among both local buyers and foreign investors taking advantage of the new property ownership laws.

Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global , commented: “Saudi Arabia remains one of our most vital growth markets, and Jeddah continues to demonstrate exceptional fundamentals. The success of our existing developments reinforces our confidence in the market and underpins our commitment to delivering world-class residences in the Kingdom. With buyers from 61 nationalities already investing in our Saudi portfolio, we are witnessing accelerating international confidence in the country's real estate sector. This new development marks another significant milestone in our global expansion strategy.”

This expanding international participation highlights the Kingdom's rising appeal as a premier destination for global real estate capital, bolstered by comprehensive regulatory reforms and the transformative momentum of Saudi Vision 2030.
Further details regarding the development, including its architectural concept, residential offerings, and official launch date, will be unveiled in due course.

headings: Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate
paragraphs: Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai.

Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets.

As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements.

In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform. The appointment follows a transformational phase for Dar Global, which recently upgraded to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category on the London Stock Exchange and expanded its global portfolio to $23 billion in Gross Development Value (GDV).

“Through Dar Global, we built an international platform serving investors from more than 125 nationalities,” said Ziad El Chaar, Chairman of Dar Global Capital Partners and CEO of Dar Global. “With DGCP, we are taking the natural next step by establishing an institutional-grade, regulated vehicle that enables investors to access compelling cross-border real estate investments through a disciplined, value-oriented framework. While we pursue acquisitions across leading global gateway cities, Dubai’s exceptional fundamentals offer strong potential for targeted capital deployment.”

DGCP provides specialized asset management and advisory capabilities designed to create long-term value for sovereign, institutional, and ultra-high-net-worth investors across international jurisdictions.

paragraphs: Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). headings: Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman
paragraphs: Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas , a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally.

The launch unveils 19 thoughtfully designed and exquisitely appointed mansions with direct beach access featuring FENDI Casa's signature Italian craftsmanship and refined high-end design to AIDA, a magnificent, gated community built on a 130-metre-high cliff, surrounded by rocky canyons, pristine beaches, and the scenic Oman coastline.

Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global , said: “The launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, at AIDA reflects Dar Global’s commitment to identifying and unlocking high-value real estate opportunities in growth markets. Oman’s luxury property sector is at a turning point, fuelled by investor appetite for branded residences and government initiatives driving inbound investment. Our partnership with FENDI Casa brings world-renowned Italian design to this vision, elevating the standard of upscale living in Muscat. Together, we are further elevating the position of  AIDA as a strategic gateway for global investors seeking long-term value, lifestyle returns, and design-led distinction in the region.”

Positioned on an expansive site with unobstructed sea views, Azure Oceanfront Villas, with interiors by FENDI Casa, offers exceptional privacy and seclusion for a select group of discerning residents. The distinctly modern mansions embody the essence of seaside living, evoking a tranquil and luxurious sanctuary. With spacious floor plans, each villa includes private amenities such as an outdoor pool and a state-of-the-art gym. Beautifully furnished, the homes reflect FENDI Casa's renowned blend of elegance and contemporary style, with curated attention to details, materials, and artisanal craftsmanship.

This elegant new landmark within AIDA marks the first collaboration between Dar Global and FENDI Casa on a high-end residential project. The unveiling also represents a significant milestone for Oman as Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, becomes the first development in the Sultanate to feature interiors by the design brand of a luxury fashion Maison.

Spanning over 4.3 million sqm and targeting international investors and buyers, AIDA blends nature, luxury, and lifestyle, boasting world-class hotels, an 18-hole golf course, an exclusive members-only club, and a bouquet of residential offerings including upscale villas and apartments. Centrally located in the Omani capital, within a short distance of Muscat International Airport and Central Downtown, this significant urban development in Oman is enhancing the country's global stature as a compelling destination for tourists, residents, and investors alike.
